title: PROD /api/health exposes full internal job detail (data-provider names, per-sport event & snapshot counts, alerts/finals/graded/closing/published breakdown) to anonymous callers; current codebase already restricts this
steps: GET https://sigmaline.netlify.app/api/health with no auth (passive read of a public endpoint).

Response includes lastJob.detail with keys [pulls, alerts, finals, graded, closing, published, simulated]; pulls lists provider='propline', events and snapshot counts per sport (e.g. cfb events=181 snapshots=72585).
expected: Per the health route's own contract ('Only the last job's name, status and times: no pull plan, providers or counts'), the endpoint must not reveal the detail jsonb.
actual: PROD (old code) returns the entire job.detail object, disclosing which paid data providers are used and the operational scale. The new code in app/src/app/api/health/route.ts already narrows lastJob to {job,status,started_at,finished_at} (QA-PAYWALL /api/health returns no detail), so shipping the current build fixes it; filing so the fix is confirmed deployed to PROD.
suspected_area: Deployed PROD build predates the health-route restriction; verify the fix ships and consider CSP (see SEC-004).
